Build passed. Here's what I did and why:

**The real problem:** iOS React Native creates a sub-pixel gap between sibling Views in a flex column. Your transparent header and the white mountains section are siblings — that ~0.5–1pt gap lets the background image leak through, creating the "separate box" look. Web Yoga rounds this to 0 so you never see it there.

**The fix:**
- `mountainsSection` now has `marginTop: -2` — pulls the entire white section up 2pt, covering the gap completely
- A `gapBridge` spacer (2pt white View) sits inside to absorb that pull, so the "122 peaks" row stays in the same spot visually

The white background now physically extends into the header area, eliminating any sliver of background image between them. Open both previews — they should match now.
